comment: No family is set on the jacks: the module scales and offsets whatever is patched, audio or CV. The SHIFT knobs are configured over -10V to 10V (SISM_info.hh:20) but SISMCore.cc:139 multiplies by maximumShiftInV, which SISMCore.cc:132 sets at 9.5V, so the knob is short of its own tooltip at both ends.
